title: Identification of peptidomimetic telomere dysfunction inhibitor (TELODIN) through telomere dysfunction-induced foci (TIF) assay
protocol: Remove the medium of cell culture and wash cells with 1×PBS once.
Fix cells with 100% cold methanol at −20°C for 10 min.
Wash cells three times with 1 mL 1× cold PBS for 5 min.
Incubate cells with blocking solution for 40 min at 15°C–25°C.
Incubate cells with primary antibody (anti 53BP1 antibody, 1:100 dilution) diluted in blocking solution for 1 h at 15°C–25°C.
Coverslips are incubated cell-side-down on antibody solution (10 μL per slide, spotted on parafilm) in a humidified chamber.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS, each for 5 min.
Incubate cells with secondary antibody (1:1000 dilution) diluted in blocking solution for 40 min at 15°C–25°C.
Coverslips are incubated cell-side-down on antibody solution (10 μL per slide, spotted on parafilm) in a humidified chamber.
Wash cells three times with 1 mL 1×PBS, each for 5 min.
Fix the cells for 5 minutes in 2% paraformaldehyde at 15°C–25°C.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each.
Dehydrate the cells in 70% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Dehydrate the cells in 95% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Dehydrate the cells in 100% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Dry the cover slips for 5–10 minutes.
Place the humidified chamber into an 80°C oven for preheating.
Mix 25 μL of hybridization solution and place it on the slide.
Flip the cover slips upside down onto the hybridization solution.
Place the slide in the preheated humidified chamber.
Denature with hybridization solution for 8 minutes at 80°C.
Remove the humidified chamber containing slides from the 80°C oven.
Place the humidified chamber containing slides in a 4°C refrigerator for 16 hours.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL of washing solution at 15°C–25°C, each for 15 minutes.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS, each for 5 minutes.
Stain the nuclear DNA with DAPI solution (0.1 μg/mL) for 5 minutes.
Wash cells once with 1 mL of PBS for 5 minutes.
Dry the slides for 10 minutes.
Place coverslips cell-side-down on the slides with one drop of antifade mounting medium, ensuring to eliminate all air bubbles.
Seal the coverslip with clear nail polish.
Store the slides at 4°C or acquire images immediately.
Set the parameters for TRITC channel with excitation at 555/28 nm and emission at 617/73 nm.
Adjust TRITC light source intensity to 50% and exposure time to 0.6 s.
Set FITC channel parameters with excitation at 490/20 nm and emission at 528/38 nm.
Adjust FITC light source intensity to 32% and exposure time to 0.5 s.
Set DAPI channel parameters with excitation at 360/40 nm and emission at 457/50 nm.
Adjust DAPI light source intensity to 2% and exposure time to 0.1 s.
Configure Z-stack distance to approximately 2 μm, focusing on the clearest middle location.
Capture an image every 0.5 μm during the Z-stack process.
Label each image with a unique name for identification.
Perform de-convolution and quick projection processes to enhance image quality.
Apply Z-projection using maximum pixel intensity method.
Collect a total of 50 images per experimental condition.
Initiate co-localization analysis by de-convoluting images followed by quick projection.
Use Image J software to perform co-localization analysis on two fluorescence signals.
Quantify the results using Image J software.
Identify relevant images in Photoshop.
Select and split channels in Image J: blue (nuclear, DAPI staining), red (telomere, PNA probe), green (53BP1, 488 secondary antibody).
Choose Plugins: CO-LOCALIZATION threshold.
Display channel 1 (red) and channel 2 (green) for analysis.
Select red and green channels in the software interface.
Click on show scatter button to visualize co-localization.
Choose Plugin and use Colocalization Finder to analyze the co-localization of channel 1 and channel 2.
Press OK button.
View results in the scatter plot windows.
Confirm co-localization: Pearson’s R value between 0.5–1.0 and Mander’s value between 0.6–1.0 is considered as co-localization.
Summarize the results by recording co-localization values in an Excel sheet.
Get the number of co-localizations in cells.
In one cell, more than 3 co-localizations of 53BP1 and telomeres are considered to be TIF positive cell.
Calculate about 300–500 cells per condition.
